$comment: Hard npm-tarball budgets against the measured pre-8.0.0 baseline. Machine-consumed editor and design-token JSON is deterministically compact; emitted declaration, CSS, JavaScript, and public-CLI whitespace is compacted without removing JSDoc, type text, public paths, or readable runtime names. That brings unpacked bytes below the approved 25% reduction target while preserving every published docs/editor/CEM/declaration path. Packed bytes use the explicit required-artifact infeasibility exception documented below: a deliberately favorable probe containing all required consumer docs/editor/CEM assets plus fully identifier-minified runtime JavaScript, but omitting every declaration, CSS file, and other required runtime artifact, still packs to 6,088,928 bytes -- 216,583 bytes above the mathematical 25% target of 5,872,345 before the omitted required artifacts are restored. Initial authored documentation corrections and their canonical required-public-asset regeneration added 3,688 packed bytes and 14,084 unpacked bytes to the prior reviewed complete package, including the 14,080-byte llms-full.txt growth, producing a 6,929,625-byte reviewed measurement. Later integrated generated output consumed part of that headroom. The final manifest-driven IDL-default documentation sweep adds 4,394 required unpacked bytes across llms-full.txt and 17 self-contained component references without adding package files. Exact Node 22.23.2/npm 10.9.8 packs move from 6,932,102 packed / 28,851,327 unpacked bytes at the parent commit to 6,933,420 packed / 28,855,721 unpacked bytes now. The complete required package is therefore re-reviewed at 6,933,420 packed bytes; its 6,936,335-byte ceiling retains exactly 2,915 bytes (0.042%) of tool/version headroom, and validation rejects headroom above 0.5%. The file ceiling is the prior 2,500-artifact base plus two emitted files for each of 285 stable lr-* alias entries, the measured 82-file entrypoint remainder, and seven non-alias artifacts of next-component scaffold headroom; incrementing the stable alias count budgets that component's two alias files separately. Source/map rejection remains independent. The 14.0.0 library-wide correctness/accessibility/hardening pass grows emitted runtime JavaScript by about 254 KB unpacked (bounded projections, descriptor-safe boundaries, owner-realm lifecycle guards across the component families) plus about 100 KB of manifest, editor-data, and llms documentation for the same surfaces; in the same change the published JavaScript compaction switched esbuild to the utf8 charset, so the translation catalogs ship their characters instead of six-byte escapes, recovering about 300 KB unpacked. Exact Node 22.23.2 packs of the complete required package now measure 6,989,321 packed / 28,935,133 unpacked bytes: 24.9% below the unpacked baseline, 52,570 bytes past the mathematical 25% target of 28,882,563 with every published docs/editor/CEM/declaration path retained, so unpacked bytes now carry the same measured required-artifact exception as packed bytes. Both ceilings keep 0.5%-bounded headroom (34,000 packed / 140,000 unpacked bytes) sized for the release commit's CHANGELOG and package-metadata growth and tool/version variance; validation still rejects headroom above 0.5%, an exception whose reviewed measurement does not exceed the target, and any ceiling at or above the pre-8 baseline.
